scope: SOURCE-FORMULA diagnostics, candidate dynamics and controls. Not original Chamber dynamics or quantum probabilities.

source_semantics.phi: Source loops mu=1.600..1.640 in 0.001 increments, minimizing mean square periodic bilinear resampling defect
source_semantics.spectrum: Source FFT of its FFT-Laplacian kappa, radial k=floor(sqrt(kx^2+ky^2)) averages power in bins, fits all bin log powers vs log integer k, p=-slope
source_semantics.entropy: Source normalized histogram of 50 bins spanning each field own min,max; H=-sum p log2(p)
source_semantics.sampling: Diagnostics evaluated at final physical time and predefined 80% tail for new candidate; distinct from original engine monitor and cached entropy times
source_semantics.original_export_spectral_p_negative: Sign convention as exported, no retuning or sign flip performed
limitations: Original JSON exports omit raw tau arrays
Phi minimizer constrained to window around golden ratio
Tiny FFT bin powers can dominate log fits
Entropy histogram varies with its own support
Original HTML entropy cache does not prove C4 without consecutive snapshots
